testcase.name: Scenario: Show and hides the Parameters panel during sketch editing: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:673:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show and hides the Parameters panel during sketch editing ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And the Sketch tab is active ✔ And the Parameters panel is hidden ✔ When the user opens the Create panel title context menu ✔ And the user opens Show Panels ✔ Then Parameters is unchecked in the panel list ✔ When the user selects Parameters ✔ Then the Parameters panel appears after Format and before Exit ✔ And the panel displays a large parameter symbol ✔ When the user opens the Create panel title context menu ✔ And the user opens Show Panels ✔ And the user selects Parameters ✔ Then the Parameters panel is hidden again ✔ And the sketch remains in edit mode
